title: Ship onboarding checklist
context: 60% of trial users drop off in the first 24 hours due to lack of guidance. Support tickets show 'How do I get started?' is the #1 question.
decision: We will add a 3-step guided onboarding checklist that appears on first login.

alternatives.reason: Higher effort to produce; lower completion rate for video content.
Drop-off continues; churn OKR at risk.

rationale: Minimal friction, measurable (completion rate), and aligns with activation OKR.

risks.mitigation: Track dismissal rate; A/B test messaging.
Start with primary persona; personalize later.

metrics.guardrails: Sign-up conversion rate must not drop

revisit_triggers: If activation rate does not improve by 20% within 60 days
If 3+ enterprise customers request SSO instead
